summary: The generated raw mcp JSON-RPC passthrough must refuse tools/call for credit-spending or unknown tools; spends go through typed commands behind --execute and the ledger.
reason: Pin Generator multiplexes paid and free tools on one tools/call endpoint, so a raw passthrough would bypass the credit guard; the spec also hides the raw endpoint from the MCP server (mcp.endpoint_tools: hidden).
validated_outcome: TestPassthroughCannotSpendCredits and TestPassthroughRejectsCaseVariantName: zero server calls for spending or case-variant names.
